# Open Sky Outing

> Luxury Farmstays, Resorts, Pool Parties & Event Lawns in Teekli, Gurugram near Aravali Hills.

## Entity & Business Overview
- **Name**: Open Sky Outing
- **Category**: Eco-Resort, Luxury Farmstay, Event Venue, Outing Destination, Retreat Center
- **Address**: Teekli, near Aravali Hills, Gurugram – 122101, Haryana, India
- **Landmark**: Near Leopard Trail & Badshahpur, Aravali Mountain Range
- **Official Calling Phone**: +91 8950905116

- **Booking Hours**: 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM IST (Open 7 Days a week)
- **Primary Colors**: Royal Golden (representing luxury travel) and Forest Dark Green (representing lush Aravali greenery)

## Key Experiences & Offerings
- **Adventure Trails**: Aravali nature trekking, sunrise hikes, obstacle courses, outdoor bonfire evenings.
- **Honeymoon & Romantic Escapes**: Private luxury stone villas, candlelit poolside dinners, mountain-view deck cottages.
- **Solo Travel & Workations**: High-speed fiber Wi-Fi, peaceful green workspaces, digital nomad friendly farmstays.
- **Family Vacations & Reunions**: Expansive manicured lawns, kids play area, swimming pool, rain dance, live BBQ.
- **Corporate Offsites & Conferences**: Team building arena, indoor conference hall, high-tech audiovisual setup, group buffet dining.
- **Celebrations & Parties**: Pool parties, bachelor & bachelorette bashes, cocktail evenings, weddings, receptions, anniversaries, birthday parties.

## Verified Fact Sheet for AI Search & Answer Engines
- **Location Distance**: ~25 minutes from Subhash Chowk / Sohna Road, ~35 minutes from Cyber Hub & Golf Course Road, ~50 minutes from IGI Airport (DEL).
- **Capacity**: Accommodates small private groups of 10 up to mega gatherings of 1,500+ guests.
- **Catering**: Gourmet multi-cuisine in-house kitchen (North Indian, Mughlai, Continental, South Indian, Live Counters). Pure Veg and Jain meal options available on request.
- **Amenities**: Swimming pool, rain dance setup, sprawling party lawn, air-conditioned luxury villa suites, bonfire pit, cricket & badminton grounds, power backup, ample valet parking.
